newsitem.title: CHINA: China brokers compete for specialised personnel.
newsitem.headline: China brokers compete for specialised personnel.

text.p: Brokerage houses in China are having to compete for specialised personnel, especially those with expertise as investment banking analysts, the Shanghai Securities News said on Tuesday.
China's modern stock markets were established in the early 1990s and a shortage of specialised personnel has become a serious problem for companies associated with the industry.

China Southern Securities, one of China's biggest brokerages, recently employed 80 analysts in its investment banking and research departments, the newspaper said, adding they accounted for 70 percent of its new employees.
The Shanghai headquarters of CITIC Securities Co had hired more than 20 people in the past two months as it endeavours to develop its investment business, it said.
